The '''laa''' was a [[Scalefish/Legends|scalefish]] native to the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==Biology and appearance==
The typical laa was a green-scaled fish with a long snout and a broad tail. The laa also had a long, thin dorsal fin tipped with a bio-luminescent bulb. This bulb helped attract the favorite prey of the laa, the [[Yobshrimp/Legends|yobshrimp]].<ref name="CSWE" /> Laa also picked out yobshrimp from the gills of [[Tee/Legends|tee]], which, despite being voracious, did not harm the laa for the yobshrimp were parasitic to the tee.<ref name="WSWFG" />

Its own predators included [[See/Legends|sees]] and [[Opee sea killer/Legends|opee]] sea killers.<ref name="WSWFG" />

==Behavior==
[[File:Laa-TheWildlifeOfSW.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A group of laas, one about to eat a yobshrimp]]
Like several other fish, the laa were attracted to the bright lights of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]], but learned by experience not to pass through the membrane openings to the air-filled domes.<ref name="EpIVD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref><ref name="CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==History==
Laa existed in the waters of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the planet by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. They were present in [[Lake Paonga/Legends|Lake Paonga]] as [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] swam down to the city of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]] to speak with Gungan representatives.<ref name="TPM" />
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], laa, along with [[Ray/Legends|ray]], [[Faa/Legends|faa]] and [[Mee/Legends|mee]], were present in a holding tank aboard the ''[[Titavian IV]]'', an exploration vessel formerly operated by the [[Intergalactic Zoological Society]] on [[Mycroft]] whose mission was to gather and catalog specimens from across the galaxy.<ref name="Rendili">[[Republic 69|''Republic'' 69]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Laa, along with its musically-influenced scalefish cousins, the [[Doo/Legends|doo]], [[Ray/Legends|ray]], [[Mee/Legends|mee]], [[Faa/Legends|faa]], [[See/Legends|see]], and [[Tee/Legends|tee]], first appeared in the deep waters of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" /> They were later illustrated by [[Terryl Whitlatch]] in the [[2001]] reference book ''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]'',<ref name="WSWFG" /> and referenced in the [[2004]] comic [[Republic 69|''Republic'' 69]].<ref name="Rendili" />
